<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>EXHIBIT 99.1 </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">


<IMG SRC="g108869g0713181639211.jpg" ALT="LOGO">
 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Sunbelt Rentals Appoints Ekta Singh-Bushell to Board of Directors </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">July&nbsp;13, 2026 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4:05 p.m. ET </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Fort Mill, S.C. &#8212;(BUSINESS WIRE)&#8212; Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: SUNB, LSE: SUNB) (&#8220;the company&#8221;), a leader in the equipment
rental industry, today announced that Ekta Singh-Bushell has been appointed to the company&#8217;s Board of Directors as a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-executive</FONT> director, effective August&nbsp;1, 2026. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Ms.&nbsp;Singh-Bushell brings extensive public board and executive leadership experience across finance, audit, technology, business transformation and
cybersecurity. She currently serves on the boards of directors of ChargePoint, Inc. and Lesaka Technologies Inc., where she holds multiple committee roles. In addition, she is a founding board member of Women&#8217;s Health Access Matters and chairs
the finance committee. She previously served as a director for Cisco Systems, Inc., TTEC Holdings, Inc., Designer Brands, Inc. and Datatec Limited. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;We are fortunate to add Ekta&#8217;s breadth of experience across finance, technology and cybersecurity to our Board of Directors,&#8221; said Paul
Walker, chairman of Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. &#8220;Her experience will complement our Board&#8217;s existing strengths and support our continued focus on creating long-term growth.&#8221; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Most recently, Ms.&nbsp;Singh-Bushell served as chief operating officer of Dragos Inc., a privately held global cybersecurity company specializing in
industrial control systems. Previously, she held leadership positions at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Ernst&nbsp;&amp; Young, where she served in senior technology, innovation and cybersecurity roles, including chief information security
officer. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">She holds an M.S. in electrical engineering and computer science from the University of California, Berkeley, and a bachelor&#8217;s degree in
engineering from the University of Poona in India. Ms.&nbsp;Singh-Bushell is a certified public accountant, a National Association of Corporate Directors fellow and holds advanced international certifications in governance, sustainability,
information systems security, audit and control. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>About Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc., operating primarily as Sunbelt Rentals, is a leading global provider of rental equipment and services based in Fort Mill, South
Carolina. Our passionate, customer-centric team of 26,000 employees combines execution-focused resolve with Sunbelt Rentals&#8217; innovative array of rental solutions across a vast network of over 1,600 locations and with a fleet of assets
exceeding $19&nbsp;billion. Sunbelt Rentals is committed to delivering unrivaled quality and support for its customers across an increasingly diverse array of industries, project types and end markets, including construction, live events,
maintenance and countless emerging applications ranging from small-scale developments to mega projects. </P>
</DIV></Center>
